reference: Why do they wait? Because the bread must rise.
sk: Prečo čakajú? Lebo chlieb musí vykysnúť.
cz: Proč čekají? Protože chleba musí vykynout.
acceptable: {Why do they wait|Why are they waiting}? Because the bread {must|has to|needs to} rise.

mistakes.text: Why they wait? Because the bread must rise.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V otázke chýba „do“: „Why do they wait?“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V otázce chybí „do“: „Why do they wait?“.

mistakes.text: Why does they wait? Because the bread must rise.
Why do they waiting? Because the bread must rise.
Why do they wait? Because the bread must to rise.
Why do they wait? Because the bread must raise.
